firmographic.name: Attio
firmographic.company_description:
Attio is a London-based, privately held AI-native CRM company founded in 2019, serving startups, scale-ups, venture capital firms, and AI-native companies. The platform is built around a flexible, user-configurable data model that supports custom objects (Partnership, Project, Invoice, Fund, Workspace) alongside standard CRM entities, allowing customers in venture capital (Seedcamp, USV), generative AI (Lovable, Modal, Replicate, Granola), developer tools (Railway), fintech (Public.com), and consumer brands (Coca-Cola) to model their business shape without developer support. The company's core product surface spans a CRM platform, Ask Attio (natural-language AI assistant), Universal Context™ (a proprietary AI context layer that compounds email, calendar, call, support, billing, and product signals), Workflows (orchestrating 13+ pre-built AI agents with a no-code builder), Call Intelligence (native recording, transcription, and analysis), Sequences, and Reporting, with native distribution via iOS, Android, macOS, Chrome, and Slack apps.

Underlying technology is API-first: Attio exposes a public REST API with OAuth 2.0, JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs, webhooks, an OpenAPI spec, a sandbox, an App SDK, and a hosted MCP server at mcp.attio.com/mcp that enables MCP-compatible AI clients to read and write records. The platform supports bring-your-own-key AI across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Gemini, and is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 with GDPR, CCPA, and EU AI Act compliance. Attio does not train its own models on customer data.

Revenue is generated primarily through per-seat SaaS subscriptions — Plus at $29/seat/month (annual) and Pro at $69/seat/month (annual), with Enterprise custom-priced — augmented by a Free tier (up to 3 seats) as a PLG acquisition funnel, usage-based Credits for enrichment and AI features, and Enterprise implementation/onboarding services. Distribution is hybrid: self-serve PLG plus sales-assisted Enterprise, supported by an App Marketplace, Hire-an-Expert directory, partner programs, and a referral scheme. As of August 2025 the company had raised $116M cumulatively across seed (Point Nine-led, $7.7M, 2021), Series A (Redpoint-led, $23.5M, 2023), a 2024 round ($33M), and a Series B (GV-led, $52M), with capital earmarked for AI R&D and engineering expansion. The company is led by co-founder and CEO Nicolas Sharp and co-founder and CTO Alexander Christie.

recent_move.description: Closed $52M Series B led by GV (Google Ventures), bringing total funding to $116M, with capital earmarked to accelerate AI-native CRM R&D and expand engineering hires.
Established Attio Inc., a Delaware corporation, as the US contracting entity for American customers accepting the Services Agreement on or after 5 November 2025, formalizing US market presence.
Launched Universal Context™, a proprietary AI context layer that compounds every customer signal into a single substrate for AI agents and humans — the platform's core architectural differentiator.

Launched Workflows, an AI agent orchestration layer shipping 13+ pre-built agents (Web, Scoring, Routing, Win/Loss, Onboarding, Coaching, Prospecting, Enrichment, Briefing, Follow-Up, Churn Risk, Expansion, Pipeline Review, Outbound) with no-code builder and MCP integration.

Released hosted Attio MCP Server at mcp.attio.com/mcp with OAuth 2.0 authentication, allowing MCP-compatible AI clients (Claude Desktop, etc.) to read and write Attio records via the Model Context Protocol.
Achieved ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification covering all production infrastructure, alongside GDPR and CCPA compliance posture and EU AI Act alignment — gating enterprise procurement.

Attio established Attio Inc., a corporation incorporated under the laws of Delaware with its registered office at 8 The Green #13469, Dover, DE 19901, United States, to serve US-located customers accepting the Services Agreement on or after 5 November 2025.
recent_move.title: Attio Inc. US Entity Incorporation

expansion_highlight.description: Incorporation of Attio Inc. (Delaware) on 5 November 2025 to serve US customers signals formal North American market commitment beyond the UK/EMEA base, with a registered US office in Dover, DE.

Workflows with 13+ pre-built AI agents and Universal Context (2025) shift Attio from a CRM product into an AI-agent orchestration platform, expanding the addressable surface from CRM seats to AI-driven revenue workflows.
Hosted MCP server at mcp.attio.com/mcp, App SDK, App Marketplace, Approved Developer Program, and partner programs for developers/creators/consultants signal deliberate platform ecosystem expansion.
$52M Series B funding explicitly earmarked for engineering hires and AI R&D expansion, against a current 51–100 employee base, implying significant headcount growth in 2026.

Targeting the $50B+ CRM market with explicit positioning against Salesforce and HubSpot, plus the Enterprise tier launch with SSO/SAML, audit logs, and custom data residency, signals an offensive move upmarket from startups to enterprise.

GV (Google Ventures) leading the $52M Series B in August 2025 — a strategic investor that brings both capital and ecosystem credibility — supports expansion runway of approximately 24–36 months at current burn.
